name: Potential
overview: Scripture reveals that human potential is rooted in being created in God's own image, as seen in Genesis 1:27, which establishes the inherent dignity and purpose of mankind. God’s blessing to be fruitful, multiply, and exercise dominion (Genesis 1:28) further affirms the intended capacity for growth and stewardship. The Lord’s intimate involvement in our formation (Psalms 139:13) and His plans for our future filled with hope and peace (Jeremiah 29:11) underscore that our potential is both divinely designed and sustained. Additionally, the unity and creativity of humanity, as noted in Genesis 11:6, demonstrate the vast possibilities God has allowed within His sovereign boundaries.
